attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Removing the [FormValueRequired(\"submit.Delete\")] filter and changing DeletePart to a standalone HttpPost action moves delete from a form-submit pattern to a direct link/route call, which is low risk for core behavior but could affect any custom views/extensions that still POST to EditPart with submit.Delete expecting the old routing."}

reason: Removing the [FormValueRequired("submit.Delete")] filter and changing DeletePart to a standalone HttpPost action moves delete from a form-submit pattern to a direct link/route call, which is low risk for core behavior but could affect any custom views/extensions that still POST to EditPart with submit.Delete expecting the old routing.
